page.overview:
Who is Aethis Flamebearer?

Not to be confused with Aethis the Poet. Aethis Flamebearer is a proud High Elven Dragon Prince of Caledor, a brave and unforgiving warrior, and a skillful general in the field. Well-respected as a military commander, if not well-liked amongst the other Asur nobles of Ulthuan, he was as an obvious choice when it was decided unanimously that the armies of Ulthuan would travel to Albion. The High Elves would aid the Truthsayers' cause, for they saw that it truly was their cause as well.

Aethis comes from the mountainous kingdom of Caledor in south-western Ulthuan. It is a land of ancient power and the resting place of the great firedrakes, the steeds of the mighty Dragon Princes in ages long past. Aethis readily agreed to the journey upon hearing the news of the lost isle from the Loremasters of Hoeth. Though his exploits in warfare are beyond compare, his High Elf brethren perceive Aethis as hot-headed and impetuous. While other High Elf nobles regard him this way, the few Humans who have met him, short-lived in comparison to the almost ageless High Elves, have seen him as arrogant and aloof, cool and unemotional. He gathered his forces quickly, eager to arrive on Albion before the forces of darkness were able to converge there in strength.

Aethis' brothers and cousins had utter belief in him, and they banded together to form a powerful regiment of High Elven heavy cavalry. Their ancient and ornate Dragon-styled plate armour makes them a striking and intimidating foe. Aethis' talented younger brother Daramas returned to Caledor from his studies within the mysterious White Tower of Hoeth, the centre for the magical lore of the High Elves, determined to stand and fight at his brother's side. Accompanying Daramas was a regiment of the highly skilled and wise Swordmasters of Hoeth, who had pledged to protect the young Daramas, and to fight alongside Aethis.

The powerful Dragon Prince headed into the mountains the day before the army was due to set sail, walking through the labyrinthine tunnels that riddle the mountains and extinct volcanoes that cover Caledor. Aethis succeeded in waking the mighty Blue Dragon Karnasyllae, who had slept for countless millennia. The ancient Dragon listened to the Dragon Prince's words, and decided to aid the High Elf, and to travel to the long hidden land of Albion with him.
